program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # bottom mirror pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # bottom pair L (ro, matching)
    "gmidc": (22.0, 16.0, 26.0),     # cascode gm/Id (weak inversion -> low Vdsat)
    "Lc":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # cascode L
    "vds1":  (0.10, 0.07, 0.16),     # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", spec.get("iref", 20e-6))
    vnom = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vds1 = p["vds1"]
    # bottom devices (reference & mirror identical -> ratio 1)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=vds1)
    # cascodes: source at vds1 (body effect included)
    mc_ref = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I, vds=max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.2), vsb=vds1)
    mc_out = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I, vds=vnom - vds1, vsb=vds1)
    # cascode gate = Vgs1 + I*R ; Vds1 = Vg_c - Vgs_c  ->  R = (vds1 + Vgs_c - Vgs1)/I
    R = (vds1 + mc_ref.vgs - m1.vgs) / I
    R = min(max(R, 100.0), 1e6)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # reference branch: iin -> R -> nd (drain of ref cascode), bottom-pair gate at nd
    n.R("RB", "iin", "nd", R)
    n.dev("MC1", "nd", "iin", "x1", "vss", mc_ref)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nd", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # mirror branch: identical devices
    n.dev("MC2", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", mc_ref)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nd", "vss", "vss", m1)

    # predictions
    gds1 = max(m1.gds, 1e-12)
    gain_c = (mc_out.gm + mc_out.gmbs) / max(mc_out.gds, 1e-12)
    rout = gain_c / gds1 + 1.0 / gds1
    dvd = vnom - m1.vgs
    dvx = dvd / max(gain_c, 1.0)
    err = 100.0 * (gds1 * dvx) / I
    vcomp = vds1 + max(3 * 0.02585, 2.0 / p["gmidc"] - 0.02)
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp,
               "power": 2 * I * 1.8}
